method: Sources found by search. Vispute 2011: PubMed record (PMID 21804427) located by search; title, authors, journal, volume, pages, design, size and findings read from the abstract on its academia.edu record (PubMed and the journal page returned a browser check). Ramirez-Campillo 2022: title, authors, journal, DOI, design, size and pooled result read from the article page on the Human Movement journal site. Hall 2011: reused from content/evidence/poc1.json (verified on PMC on 2026-10-17). Seed source Ramirez-Campillo 2013 (DOI 10.1519/JSC.0b013e31827e8681, PMID 23222084) confirmed bibliographically only, so not used for a claim.

claims.claim: في تجربة عشوائية، أدى أشخاص سبعة تمارين للبطن، خمسة أيام أسبوعيًا، لستة أسابيع، دون تغيير أكلهم، فلم تنقص دهون بطونهم، لكن تحمّل عضلاتهم تحسّن.
claims.source_title: The effect of abdominal exercise on abdominal fat
claims.authors: Vispute SS, Smith JD, LeCheminant JD, Hurley KS
claims.journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research, 25(9):2559-2564
claims.population: Healthy sedentary adults aged 18-40 (14 men, 10 women)
claims.main_finding: Seven abdominal exercises, 2 sets of 10 repetitions, 5 days a week for 6 weeks, on an isocaloric diet, did not significantly change body weight, body fat percentage, android fat, abdominal circumference or abdominal and suprailiac skinfolds; curl-up endurance improved more than in the control group.
claims.limitations: Small sample and short duration; sedentary participants; abdominal training only, without diet change or other exercise.

claims.claim: ومراجعة لثلاث عشرة دراسة لم تجد أن تمرين عضلة بعينها يذيب الدهون فوقها تحديدًا.
claims.source_title: A proposed model to test the hypothesis of exercise-induced localized fat reduction (spot reduction), including a systematic review with meta-analysis
claims.authors: Ramirez-Campillo R, Andrade DC, Clemente FM, Afonso J, Perez-Castilla A, Gentil P
claims.population: Studies comparing fat in a trained versus untrained body region
claims.main_finding: Pooled effect Hedges' g = -0.03 (95% CI -0.10 to 0.05), p = 0.508, low heterogeneity; 'Localized muscle training had no effect on localized adipose tissue depots.'
claims.limitations: Mostly limb-versus-limb comparisons. A 2023 trial on PMC (PMC10680576) is titled 'Abdominal aerobic endurance exercise reveals spot reduction exists' (seen by title only; the page could not be read), so the evidence may not be unanimous. The script therefore says only that the review did not find it.

claims.claim: لبطن أنحف، ركّز على خسارة الدهون عمومًا، ودرّب بطنك لتقوية عضلاته.
claims.source_title: Quantification of the effect of energy imbalance on bodyweight; plus r003-c1 (endurance gain) and r003-c2
claims.authors: Hall KD, Sacks G, Chandramohan D, Chow CC, Wang YC, Gortmaker SL, Swinburn BA
claims.study_type: Takeaway combining an energy-balance model with the trial and review above
claims.main_finding: Body fat falls with a sustained energy deficit; local abdominal training did not reduce local fat but improved abdominal muscle endurance.
claims.limitations: General guidance, not individual advice; no promise of a result.
